title: 1491: New Revelations of the Americas Before Columbus
author: Charles C. Mann
summary: Charles Mann gathers research suggesting that the pre-Columbian Americas held larger, older and more sophisticated societies than once believed, and that they reshaped their landscapes.
readIf: you are curious about what historians now say about the Americas before European contact.
skipIf: you want a single narrative history, as it ranges across debates and sites.
